_note: SHA-256 of the Linux stable SDK tarball, as Google publishes it in https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/releases_linux.json. This is a lookup table keyed by the pin, NOT a second pin: client_flutter/.fvmrc alone decides which version is built, and Dockerfile reads it. A version with no row here stops the build and names the row to add, rather than fetching an SDK it cannot verify. 3.47.5 is kept although .fvmrc pins 3.47.3: this Dockerfile hardcoded 3.47.5 until repo.gate-pairs learned to read Dockerfiles, and a row that lets the previous image rebuild is worth its two lines.
